text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, June 16 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - One vessel loading, 4 due by 2/7, no delays.
Hay Point - Maintenance shut down on berth No. 2 from 10/6-8/7. One vessel loading, 15 due by 8/7, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 12 due by 1/7, no delays.
Gladstone - Curragh mine still on strike, Gordonstone miners returned to work 14/6.
R.G. Tanna - No. 1 ship loader will be shut down for maintenance from 19-21/6. One vessel loading, 23 due by 25/7, no delays.
Barney Point - 6 Vessels due by 25/7, no delays.
Brisbane - Four vessels due by 1/7, no delays.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Port closed from 08.00 hrs. 15/6 to inward traffic due to strong winds and swell. Only selected outward movement is taking place and the next inspection is at 07.00 hrs. 17/6.
Kooragang - 1 Vessel loading, 10 waiting, 21 due by 29/6. 13 Days delay expected.
Dykes 4+5 - 1 Vessel loading, 5 waiting, 20 due by 30/6. 12 Days delay expected.
Port Kembla - Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 27 due by 26/8. 1-2 Days delay expected.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Shippers advise that due to occasional shortage of Mt. Newman lump and fines and yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some berthing/loading delays or be forced to berth out of turn. A berth - 1 vessel loading, 5 anchored, 2 due by 19/6. B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 6 anchored, 2 due by 19/6, 11 other vessels due by 10/7.
Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 1 due 21/6.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored. Possible maintenance shutdown for 24 hours from 11.00 hrs. 17/6, but berth needs to be vacant.
East Intercourse Island - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored.
Dampier line-up - 4 Vessels anchored (2 for Parker Point, 2 for East Intercourse Island). 18 Vessels due by 26/6 of which 11 for Parker Point, 7 for East Intercourse Island.
Port Walcott - 13 Vessels due by 3/7.
June 18 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay, Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - One vessel waiting to load wheat, 2 due by 26/6 of which 1 to load cs/meal, 1 wheat.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 3 due by 24/6, all to load wheat.
Sydney - No further grain loading expected at this port.
Port Kembla - Two vessels loading wheat, 3 waiting to load wheat, 8 due by end-June of which 7 to load wheat, 1 canola. Berthing programme based on grade of cargo received by rail.
Victoria - Geelong - Three vessels due by 25/6 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 canola. Portland - Four vessels due by 8/7 of which 2 to load peas, 2 wheat.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One vessel loading wheat, 1 due 24/6 to load wheat. Port Adelaide - Four vessels due by 28/6 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 canola, 1 barley.
Thevenard, Ardrossan, Port Giles - No vessels due.
Port Lincoln - Two vessels due by 28/6 of which 1 to load canola, 1 wheat/triticale.
Wallaroo - One vessel due 25/6 to load wheat.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Six vessels due by 1/7 of which 4 to load wheat, 2 lupins.
Kwinana - Two vessels loading wheat, 8 due by 2/7 of which 6 to load wheat, 2 lupins.
Albany - One vessel loading barley, 4 due by 28/6 of which 1 to load lupins, 1 canola, 1 wheat, 1 oats.
Esperance - One vessel due 22/6 to load canola.
